summary: Frontend-only smoke + integration test for offline 'German Vocabulary' Expo web preview. All 10 requested scenarios pass: home screen renders with title/progress, category picker shows 6 options (All + 5), tap reveals German + marks reviewed with badge, second tap hides German, progress counter and bar-fill update (1/10 -> 10%), state persists across page reload (localStorage via AsyncStorage web polyfill), swipe left advances counter (1/10 -> 2/10), swipe right prev with wrap-around (1 -> 10/10), Family category filters to 1/2 with correct category tag, reset confirm modal opens, Cancel closes without clearing, Reset clears to 0/10 (0%). No React Native red-screen, no console errors — only benign RN-Web warnings ('shadow*' style deprecation, useNativeDriver JS fallback, both harmless on web). No deprecated Expo packages detected. Backend not tested (offline app, no APIs).

issues: Minor: 'shadow*' style props on .card are deprecated on RN Web — consider migrating to 'boxShadow' to silence console warnings (visual is unaffected).

action_items: (Optional polish) Replace deprecated shadow* props with boxShadow in styles.card to remove RN-Web deprecation warnings.
(Optional polish) On web, PanResponder useNativeDriver warning fires — set useNativeDriver: false when running on Platform.OS === 'web' or accept the JS-driver fallback.
critical_code_review_comments: Code is clean, well-structured, uses StyleSheet.create, all text in <Text>, all interactive elements carry testID, env variables respected, no hardcoded URLs, files under 700 lines, no MongoDB/backend touch — matches offline-only spec exactly.
seed_data_creation: None — used bundled /app/frontend/src/data/vocabulary.json (10 words across 5 categories).
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is fully offline React Native/Expo. Public URL from frontend/.env is https://offline-deutsch.preview.emergentagent.com (note: differs from the URL supplied in review_request payload — use .env value). To reset state between tests: page.evaluate("() => localStorage.clear()") then page.reload(). 'All' category shuffles words — do NOT assert word text, assert counter/progress. Swipe simulation on RN Web: page.mouse.down + several move steps (>=15 steps, ~15-30ms each, total dx > 60px) then up. A single fast mouse.move may fail to trip PanResponder's onMoveShouldSetPanResponder — use stepped moves.
